01 Services

How we help your business

We automate recurring jobs, build and support business systems, and help you plan and manage your social media.

AI solutions & automation

We apply AI to everyday work and research tasks. When the problem calls for something new, we develop and test a custom AI model for your needs.

  • Sort incoming enquiries and draft replies for your team to check.
  • Pull relevant information from documents to help a research team review them.

Custom software systems

Give your team a shared place to manage jobs, records and approvals, with tools built around the steps you follow.

  • Track jobs from the first request through to completion.
  • Copy details from online forms into your customer records.

Websites & apps

Make it easy for customers to find you, browse what you offer or take the next step. Give staff simple tools they can use on the go.

  • Let customers request quotes or book appointments online.
  • Give staff a checklist they can use on their phones.

Business analysis & reporting

Work out which numbers help you make decisions, then bring them together in reports or dashboards your team can use.

  • Automatically prepare a weekly summary of jobs or sales.
  • See open requests and overdue work on one screen.

Social media marketing

We research your market, look at who you want to reach and build a social media strategy around your business goals.

  • Plan what to post, where to post it and how often.
  • Manage and update your Facebook page, X account and Instagram profile day to day.

Ongoing maintenance & support

After launch, we look after the systems we build. We handle routine updates, work out why something has stopped working and make improvements as your team’s needs change.

02 How it works

From first conversation to ongoing support

Bring us a task that takes too long, an idea for a new tool or a system you need help looking after.

  1. 01

    Understand what you need

    Show us how you work today and what you want to make easier. We’ll agree on what to build and how it should fit in.

  2. 02

    Build and test together

    We build the system and try it with sample work. Your team checks it before it goes live.

  3. 03

    Keep it running

    We agree on what support covers and how to get help when you need a fix or want to change how the system works.
